A straight chain of one-nested-table-per-cell tables renders as pipe tables, not a broken layout list

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td><table><tr><td><table><tr><td>leaf</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></td></tr></table>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
